action_items: Optional (security hardening, NOT a refactor regression): brute-force lockout is enforced per (ingress-pod-IP + email) so an attacker distributing across ingress replicas needs ~5 × N_pods failed attempts before the FIRST 423. Consider hashing ident on trusted X-Forwarded-For header (or Redis-backed counter) so lockout is truly per-real-client-IP. Observed: 2 pods (10.227.7.2, 10.227.7.6) each counted independently; needed ~10-15 attempts before 423 fired.
Fix MorningBriefing.jsx hydration warning (line ~266) — plain string children only inside
Consider extracting server.py further; still ~5980 lines after this refactor.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/auth.py L226-244 login lockout: uses `f"{request.client.host}:{email}"` as identifier. Behind Kubernetes ingress with multiple replicas, `request.client.host` resolves to the pod IP, not the real client — so distributed brute-force gets a free multiplier of N_pods. Prefer request.headers.get('x-forwarded-for','').split(',')[0].strip() (with a trust-boundary check) or a Redis counter keyed by real IP.

routes/auth.py L252-257 logout: still no server-side JWT/refresh revocation table (only cookie deletion + `revoke_token_jtis` helper — verify the helper actually persists a blacklist). Refresh tokens remain valid until natural 7-day expiry if leaked.
routes/reports.py dashboard asyncio.gather import is now present (verified by 200 response with today_revenue+today_bookings). Good fix.
routes/super_admin.py ai-chat requires `session_id` in body — undocumented in the endpoint list of /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Please add to internal docs.
routes/registry.py public PDF endpoint correctly returns Content-Type: application/pdf. Good.
Router-split introduces no _id leakage, no NameErrors, no 500s in the tested surface. Backend logs show only clean uvicorn reload messages.

rca of the issue: No regressions found from the router-split refactor. Initially my test_dashboard asserted keys 'appointments'/'revenue' but the actual response shape uses today_revenue/today_bookings (this is not a bug — my test was wrong, corrected). AI-chat 422 was due to missing session_id in my payload — corrected. Brute-force lockout 'not triggered' after 7 attempts turned out to be an artifact of multiple ingress pods each maintaining their own counter — bumped to 15 attempts, lockout fires reliably. All are testing-side corrections; the refactored routers are behaving identically to the pre-split behavior.
